reference_sql:
SELECT split_part(s.store_code, '-', 1) AS store_prefix, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE p.sku <> UPPER(TRIM(p.sku))
GROUP BY split_part(s.store_code, '-', 1)

  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.quantity
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE p.sku <> UPPER(TRIM(p.sku))
)
SELECT split_part(s.store_code, '-', 1) AS store_prefix, SUM(b.quantity) AS units
FROM bad_lines b
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = b.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql:
WITH bad_lines AS (  -- one row per order line of a product with a sku off the standard
  SELECT ol.order_id, ol.quantity
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE p.sku <> UPPER(TRIM(p.sku))
)
SELECT split_part(s.store_code, '-', 1) AS store_prefix, SUM(b.quantity) AS units
FROM bad_lines b
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = b.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: A named step keeps the off-standard lines first and joins the stores after, but one joined query is shorter.
